title: Board Presentation
subtitle: Presenting quarterly strategy to a board of directors — for English learners

sentences.en: Thank you, Madam Chair, and good morning to the board. I'll keep my opening remarks brief and reserve time for questions.
sentences.target: Thank you, Madam Chair, and good morning to the board. I'll keep my opening remarks brief and reserve time for questions.

sentences.en: Despite continued macroeconomic headwinds, the company delivered another quarter of double-digit revenue growth.
sentences.target: Despite continued macroeconomic headwinds, the company delivered another quarter of double-digit revenue growth.

sentences.en: Gross margin expanded by 180 basis points year over year, driven primarily by improvements in our supply chain.
sentences.target: Gross margin expanded by 180 basis points year over year, driven primarily by improvements in our supply chain.

sentences.en: Operating expenses came in slightly above guidance, reflecting accelerated investment in our enterprise sales motion.
sentences.target: Operating expenses came in slightly above guidance, reflecting accelerated investment in our enterprise sales motion.

sentences.en: We made this trade-off deliberately, and early pipeline indicators suggest the returns will materialize within four quarters.
sentences.target: We made this trade-off deliberately, and early pipeline indicators suggest the returns will materialize within four quarters.

sentences.en: Customer retention remains exceptionally strong, with net revenue retention holding above 120 percent for the eighth consecutive quarter.
sentences.target: Customer retention remains exceptionally strong, with net revenue retention holding above 120 percent for the eighth consecutive quarter.

sentences.en: Looking forward, we see three strategic priorities competing for capital, and I'd welcome the board's perspective on sequencing them.
sentences.target: Looking forward, we see three strategic priorities competing for capital, and I'd welcome the board's perspective on sequencing them.

sentences.en: First, expanding our international footprint, beginning with two adjacent European markets in the back half of the year.
sentences.target: First, expanding our international footprint, beginning with two adjacent European markets in the back half of the year.

sentences.en: Second, deepening our enterprise platform with a set of capabilities that several large customers have explicitly requested.
sentences.target: Second, deepening our enterprise platform with a set of capabilities that several large customers have explicitly requested.

sentences.en: Third, evaluating a potential tuck-in acquisition that would meaningfully accelerate our roadmap in artificial intelligence.
sentences.target: Third, evaluating a potential tuck-in acquisition that would meaningfully accelerate our roadmap in artificial intelligence.

sentences.en: I won't pretend any of these decisions are straightforward, and we'll need to make difficult prioritization calls in the coming weeks.
sentences.target: I won't pretend any of these decisions are straightforward, and we'll need to make difficult prioritization calls in the coming weeks.

sentences.en: With that, I'd like to open the floor to questions, and my leadership team is here to provide any additional detail you may need.
sentences.target: With that, I'd like to open the floor to questions, and my leadership team is here to provide any additional detail you may need.
